title: Alleged Deepfake Video Depicts Former President of Kenya Uhuru Kenyatta Announcing 2027 Presidential Bid

behaviors.text: Reported digital forensics and visual inconsistencies confirm the video is an AI-generated deepfake, using archival footage from his presidency with synthesized audio.
A widely shared TikTok video purportedly manipulated by AI depicts former Kenyan president a person announcing a 2027 presidential run.
